utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good to me, Leo—we’ll start with the leaking shed roof at 9 on Saturday, and I’ll keep helping gather tools, screws, and extension cords so we’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect—roof first at 9 on Saturday. We’ve got ladders covered, so please focus on screws and extension cords, and I’ll line up the rest.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it, Leo—I’ll round up screws and extension cords before Saturday so we’re set to tackle the shed roof first thing at 9.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli—I’ll be there at 9 with the drill, screwdrivers, and tape measure, and I can stay a few hours to help out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Gus—that gives us a solid start. Be at the east entrance at 9, and we’ll keep the list simple and get the first repairs moving right away.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Eli—I’ll head to the east entrance for 9 with the drill, screwdrivers, and tape measure, and I can stick around through the morning.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, not yet—I’m still turned around on the latest Maple-and-Cedar count and what’s actually been verified on hand, so I need to check before I can confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Okay—please double-check the date, location, Maple-and-Cedar open-request count, and the exact tools and supplies verified on hand, and then we can move forward.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, I do know the drive’s still Saturday in the parking lot from 10 to 2, but I’m still missing the confirmed Maple-and-Cedar count and the verified tools and supplies on hand.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, thanks, Vik—it’s this Saturday at the community center parking lot from 10 to 2, and I’ll keep passing that along even if I show up toolbox-less.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, that’s the plan—this Saturday at the community center parking lot from 10 to 2, and I’ve been repeating it to everyone so it sticks.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—this Saturday at the community center parking lot from 10 to 2, and I’ll keep saying it back so I don’t muddle it again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rosa, we’re still short on shingles, two working drills, and extra gloves for the repair drive—if you can bring any of that, I’ll put your name on my list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo—I can bring extra gloves and I’ll check tonight whether I can round up shingles and a second drill before Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That helps a lot, Rosa—I've got you down for extra gloves, and let me know tonight if the shingles and second drill come through so I can update the list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I want to help, but I’m still waiting on the final Sunday start time and parking plan before I tell Jules or promise how long I can stay.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That helps a lot, Pia—hold off on committing for now, and I’ll get the Sunday start time and parking plan pinned down so you can decide what window works.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules—I’d rather wait for the confirmed Sunday start time and parking setup before I start spreading it around or guessing my shift.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Kira, I’ve got the repair drive starting at the community center lot, with the drop-off table by the east entrance so it stays easy to track.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the time too, Opal—Oren heard both 9 by the shed and 10 by the community center, and I don’t want to pass along the wrong details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve only got the location pinned down on my notes—the community center lot with the drop-off table by the east entrance. I’d want to confirm the start time with Rosa before we pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mara, from what I’m hearing the repair drive’s really gathering momentum—people have been dropping off tools and spare parts all afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great to hear, Tess—it sounds like folks are really rallying. Gus has the main tools covered and Cleo’s tracking the gloves, tape, and spare screws, so we’re in good shape if Ira’s list doesn’t grow.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s wonderful, Mara—sounds like you’ve got the supplies side nicely buttoned up. I’m hearing a few more folks may swing by this afternoon, so the momentum’s definitely still building.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That matches what I’d heard second-hand too, Rey—Friday after pickup sounds like the tool and spare-parts drop-off, and Saturday 10 to 2 is the actual repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that’s how I understand it too. Last I heard, they’re still especially looking for screws and extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s good to know—I’d only caught the Friday drop-off part before. If you hear whether Rosa or Jules still need anything else besides screws and extension cords, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, Sunday at the community center—let’s hit the shed roof first, and do we know yet if the screws and extension cords are covered?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still only free mid-morning through early afternoon because of school pickup, and I haven’t heard that screws or extension cords are covered yet. If you want, I can check in and send a quick update once someone confirms.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, please check and let me know quick—if they’re not covered, we’ll need to round some up before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can stop by and get a quick list started for the repair drive, but I’ll need to head out again before too long.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time can you get there, and how long are you actually staying? I need a firm window if I’m putting you on the repair drive list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can be there in about twenty minutes and stay maybe forty-five, just enough to get the list started and things moving.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ah, thanks—I’m late as usual, but I can help spread the word: Saturday in the parking lot from 10 to 2, and I’ll mention we still need shingles, two working drills, and extra gloves.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks—I'm still out running errands, so keep spreading the word and send me a quick update if anything changes with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll keep passing along Saturday, 10 to 2 in the parking lot, and I’ll let you know if I hear any changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still locking in the final details for this weekend, but we’re definitely still collecting tools, screws, spare parts, plus basics like gloves and tape. I’m checking with Mara and the other groups now so I can get you the date and location pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Jules—I’ve heard Saturday in the parking lot from 10 to 2, but I clearly ought to wait for your confirmed time and place before I promise anything more.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That matches what I’ve been hearing too, so I’ll confirm Saturday and the parking lot as soon as Mara gets back to me. In the meantime, if you can keep tools and basic supplies in mind, that’ll help us keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Before I count on it, can you confirm who’s actually bringing the tools and how we’re moving the heavy stuff?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gus is bringing the drill and spare screwdrivers; I still need a firm answer on who’s handling the heavy lifting. Can you do that, and what time can you get there?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I can’t commit to the heavy lifting unless that’s confirmed first, so who’s actually handling it? If that gets pinned down, I can tell you when I can come by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that’s what I’m hearing too—Saturday’s covered pretty well on tools, so I’ll keep checking quietly on shingles and let you know if anything comes up one-on-one.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey—that lines up with what I’ve got, and I’ll note that we still need more gloves while you keep an ear out on shingles.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay—I'll keep asking around quietly about shingles, and if I hear of any gloves too, I’ll pass that along to you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday mid-morning works for me, and I’ll bring extra gloves so I can help before school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks—shed roof is still first, and Gus has the ladder and drills covered. I’ll check with Sam next so we can lock in the heavy boards.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect—that timing still works for me, and I can stay through early afternoon before pickup. Since Gus has the drills, I’ll just bring the extra gloves and be ready to help on the roof.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Ira, I’ve been telling folks the repair drive’s this Saturday at the community center parking lot from 10 to 2, and we still need shingles, two working drills, and more gloves.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik—that helps. I’m still out running errands, so keep me posted if anything changes and I’ll pass along the note about shingles, drills, and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do, Ira — I’ve been telling everyone it’s this Saturday at the community center parking lot from 10 to 2, and I’ll let you know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits and pieces, but I’m hearing they’re still collecting tools and supplies. Do you know if they still especially need screws and extension cords?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: As far as I’ve got it, Cleo specifically said we’re short on shingles, two working drills, and extra gloves; if you can bring screws or an extension cord too, bring them along and we’ll sort it at the drop-off table by the east entrance.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that helps a lot—I’d only heard about screws and extension cords, so it’s good to know they’re short on shingles, drills, and gloves too. I can ask around and bring what I can to the east entrance drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sam, we’re still short on shingles, two working drills, and extra gloves for the repair drive—if you can cover any of that, I’ll put your name on my list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can bring a working drill and a box of extra gloves, and I’ll ask around for shingles too—put me down for those.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Sam—I’ve got you down for one working drill and a box of gloves, and I’ll note that you’re checking around for shingles too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, I’m coming in late on this—can you remind me when and where the repair drive is so I can help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure — it’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 in the community center parking lot, and I’m bringing a drill along too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus — Saturday, 10 to 2 at the community center parking lot, got it. I’ll help spread the word, and if I can, I’ll try to round up an extra pair of gloves or a drill too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help once it’s locked, but I still need the final Sunday start time, parking setup, and who’s covering hauling before I tell anyone or commit my hours.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can come by and get things started, but only for a little while today. I’ve heard we still need shingles, two working drills, and extra gloves, and I’m waiting on the final Sunday time and hauling too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That matches what I’ve heard, so let’s hold the wider push until we have one confirmed Sunday start time, the parking setup, and hauling covered. If you’re only there briefly today, maybe just help pin down whether those shingles, drills, and gloves are actually lined up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right—bring tools Friday after school pickup, and if you’ve got spare screws or extension cords, that helps. I still need the first repair priority locked in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That matches what I’ve been hearing, Bo, and I’ll keep asking around so we can pin down that first repair priority before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Tess—once you hear it, send me the top fix first so I can line people up fast.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hana, I’m telling everyone about the repair drive—we still need shingles, two working drills, and extra gloves, so come by if you can and help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn—before I pass that along, can you confirm the date, location, and exactly which tools and supplies are already verified on hand?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m still spreading the word, Hana, and what’s confirmed on hand so far is folks dropping off tools this morning; what we still definitely need is shingles, two working drills, and extra gloves, so if you hear the date and spot confirmed, please help pass that along too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Noah, I’ve got the repair drive starting at the community center lot, with the drop-off table by the east entrance—does that still match your plan?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, yeah, I think so — I was a little turned around, but community center lot and the east entrance drop-off table sounds right. If anything else changed, just let me know so I can keep up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Noah — I’ve got us starting at the community center lot with the drop-off table by the east entrance, and I’ll flag you if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Nell — it’s this Saturday at the community lot by noon, and please let folks know we still need shingles, two working drills, and extra gloves.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that helps a lot — I’d only heard bits and pieces. I’ll spread the word, and if I mix anything up I’ll double-check with you about Saturday by noon at the community lot and the shingles, drills, and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Nell — that’s exactly it, and if anyone asks, tell them to bring whoever can lend a hand too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Mara, can you confirm the tool counts and who’s actually handling the heavy stuff before we call the repair drive fully set?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Gus is handling the heavy tools, and Cleo’s tracking gloves, tape, and spare screws; Ira asked me to add more screws and extension cords, so I wouldn’t call it fully set just yet.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you double-check with Gus and Cleo directly and let me know once the screws and extension cords are actually covered?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ll bring the tape measure too—I can get there at 8 and I need to head out by 1 sharp.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, 8 to 1 works—can you also handle the first round of tool setup when you get there?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely—I’ll handle the first round of tool setup when I get there at 8, and I’m still heading out at 1 sharp.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey—before I count on anything, can you confirm the date and location, plus exactly how many drills and gloves we’ve actually got and whether shingles are still on the open requests list?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I don’t want to guess, Hana—I only know Friday is drop-off and the repair drive is Saturday from 10 to 2, and I’m still checking on the drill and glove count and whether shingles are still on the open list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey—that helps; please confirm the exact location too, and once you’ve got it, send me the verified drill and glove counts and whether shingles are still on the open requests list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, so just keep me posted on the repair drive and let me know if we need anything beyond screws and extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira—right now we’re still short on shingles, two working drills, and extra gloves, and I’m waiting on the final start time. Once that’s set, I’ll send you one clear list so we can keep the repair drive simple.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect—add shingles, two working drills, and extra gloves to the list, and send me the final start time once you’ve got it while I’m still out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Small correction: it’s Saturday, 10 to 2, at the community center parking lot. We’ve got Gus’s ladder and two drills confirmed; I’m still matching people to first-priority fixes before we call the heavier boards.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right, Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center parking lot—I’ve been telling everyone that, and I’ll keep spreading the word while you sort the first-priority fixes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect—keep sharing that. For now we’ve confirmed the ladder and two drills, and I’m still lining up the first repair tasks before we ask for heavier-board help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Uli, I’ve got the repair drive pinned to the community center lot, with the drop-off table by the east entrance so everything stays easy to track.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, I can come by and get things started there, but I can only stay a little while today. I’ll make sure the drop-off table’s set up by the east entrance before I head out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, Uli—that keeps us lined up at the community center lot, and I’ll note that you’re handling the drop-off table at the east entrance before you head out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, thanks, Pia — I’m still a little turned around on the repair drive, so if anything’s changed from Saturday in the parking lot, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s exactly why I’m holding off, Noah—the day and setup keep shifting, and I don’t want to pass along the wrong details. Once they confirm the final start time, parking plan, and who’s handling hauling, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—thanks, Pia. Just give me the confirmed version once they’ve nailed it down, so I don’t mix it up again.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Rosa—I can still help spread the word, and I’ve heard we still need shingles, two working drills, and extra gloves.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane—that helps a lot. Please spread the update that it’s now Sunday at the community center, and I’ll add the shingles, two working drills, and extra gloves to the list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—I’ll pass along that it’s Sunday at the community center, and I’ll mention we still need shingles, two working drills, and extra gloves.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Uh, as far as I remember it’s still Saturday in the parking lot from 10 to 2, and I’m planning to pitch in even if I forgot my toolbox again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That matches what I’ve got, Oren—right now we’re still short on shingles, two working drills, and extra gloves, so if you can cover any of that I’ll mark it on my list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, thanks, Cleo. I don’t have shingles, but I can check if my drill still works and round up some extra gloves before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m tightening up the last details now, and I’ll reach out across the other groups so we’ve got tools, supplies, and coverage lined up. As soon as I lock in the weekend time and spot, I’ll send it over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds great, Jules—I’ve been hearing Friday after school pickup is a handy time for folks to drop off tools or spare parts, and spare screws plus extension cords seem to be the main gaps so far.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s really helpful, Tess—I’ll note Friday after pickup for drop-offs and ask Mara and the other groups to focus on spare screws and extension cords so we can fill those gaps quickly.
